# Maritime

Maritime gives your agent a persistent computer: a Linux desktop (XFCE, Chromium, LibreOffice) per end user, driven through the Maritime MCP server. Your model calls get_computer once, then works in a screenshot, act, verify loop. Desktops stay warm, sleep when idle, and keep files, browser logins, and state between sessions. For a Muse-style build, you bring the context and connectors; Maritime handles the computer it works on. Paid plans from $20/month.
